identity.realm: Sixth gate of the qi ladder and the last it is likely to hold, and the reason is arithmetic rather than anatomy. A frame built to shed heat cannot be built to store it, and a four-legged frame carries its whole mass on the forelimbs, so the twelfth and last ordinary vessel — the girdling one — has nothing to close against. This body clears the ordinary run and stops, which is the whole of its species' ceiling, and the sixth is close enough to the stop that the difference between a gate it holds and a gate it has merely arrived at is a matter of season.

appearance.presentation: Long-legged, low-headed and plated, with all of the weight carried forward and a band of network crate-paint across the ribs that the crew repaints at every tide and reassigns as often as it repaints. At any distance it reads as a line in a column.
appearance.age: Read off the ferment line in the second stomach and the wear at the rear teeth, which is how every crew on the isle reads it. It is long past the point where a litter-mate would still be recognisable by scent, and the network stopped pretending otherwise some seasons back by numbering it instead of naming it.
appearance.build: All of the mass in the forelimbs and very little worth naming in the hindquarters, on a gait built to shed rather than to hold. The narrow hindquarters are the entire reason the extraordinary network never finished assembling in this frame.
appearance.complexion: Short ash-grey fur over a smooth plate, the heat-shedding skin along the flanks bare and faintly pink, and a permanent dusting of worked tailings on the hind legs that no amount of grooming lifts because the ground it walks on is the dust.
appearance.hair: Coarse guard hairs down the spine that stand up when it is working, so the ridge of its back is an instrument it cannot switch off and does not appear to want to.
appearance.eyes: Amber, set deep under the plate's overhang, and the only part of this animal that was not built for heat.
appearance.palette: Worked jade grey and wet slate carry the isle. The residue's green appears only ever as a stain on something it has already stood in. Three values and a painted band.
appearance.attire: Nothing worn. A band of crate-paint across the ribs is the closest thing this animal has ever had to a uniform, it was never issued, and the band changes hands as often as the paint.
appearance.marks: A notched left ear with three old cuts in the lobe, a healed split at the right jaw, and — under the band — a second and older band of a different width. None of it was done for its benefit and none of it was kept.
appearance.bearing: Weight always forward and never back, head low, tail level, and a stance that reads as leaving rather than arriving. There are four photographs of it on the isle and it is facing away in every one.

canon.role_in_story: The Salt Leech exists to move a residue that has no legal owner off a piece of ground that has no legal occupant, and it keeps that work by keeping its labour off every list — so its people are numbered rather than named, because a name is a thing a body can be paid against and the network's only asset is that none of its members have one. This animal is the network's assay and not its muscle. Hauling is not the hard part of moving material off a frame whose readings do not match its parent; the hard part is deciding which crates are worth the crossing, and the network buys tolerance for that job rather than strength. What stands on the ground it came from is the Cutaway Isle — cut out of the Cloudshelf's floor when a jade seam was worked out from under it, then resealed with the same six law groups and not one of them at the value the shore holds. So the isle's arithmetic and the mainland's disagree about what the tailings are holding, and the disagreement is the entire commodity. A line is weighed at the tide gate. At the weighing this animal's number is renumbered, because a scavenger whose output can be shown to respond to it is a scavenger somebody might begin watching. That leaves the buyers holding a schedule certified by a stock line nobody is able to cross-examine — and the schedule is the product, because spirit stone is the first resource in the setting that makes a breakthrough schedulable rather than merely attempted. Every consumer of the residue is staking an ascent on a figure a numbered animal produced once, under a number that has since been retired.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a discrepancy in a stock column rather than as a sighting. Two crates in one tide's tally came back at a figure no one had weighed them to, and the only account offered was that the animal working that line had stopped working it — which could be neither confirmed nor denied, because the line was a number and the animal was not on anything. It took the counting house two seasons of tallies to conclude the reading had changed rather than the ground.
canon.lore: An ashjackal is an obligate scavenger, and every part of its construction is an argument about heat: a smooth plate over the skull to shed what a body running on spent qi cannot afford to hold, a second stomach kept permanently at ferment, a tail that is a rudder rather than a hand, and the whole mass slung onto the forelimbs so the hindquarters stay narrow. That last measurement is the whole of its cultivation story. The frame has no folding under the plate for introspection to work against, which shuts the mind path; and it has no hindquarter girth for the girdling vessel to close against, which shuts the body path — not for want of qi, of which there is more here than anywhere, but for want of a surface. What is left is the qi path, and qi is what this body eats. It draws residual qi out of ash, carcass and worked ground at a rate nothing in the record matches, and the network is a fast single loop with nothing at all to hold anything, so its breakthroughs arrive early and then simply stop. It has no vocabulary: there is no vocalisation in the species that carries meaning, and the whole channel is gland, posture and position on the air, delivered to a pack that receives everything it sends. A pack here is a kinship by scent and it comes apart when the scent changes. On a body that cannot take a healthy adult of anything — out of a live fight in under a minute, feeding on the aftermath rather than the fight — all of that makes a creature whose entire competence is finding out what is left behind and reading it at a range no sighted thing can match. On the Cutaway Isle that competence has a job. The isle was severed and resealed at drifted values, so its own readings do not agree with the shore it was cut from, the jade residue in its tailings holds qi, and holding qi is precisely what makes a strained law read as a common one. The network sells the residue ashore as spirit stone and the honest assay of it is a nose. Nobody ashore can check the animal: it is not on a roll, its line is renumbered at the tide, and leaving the isle is how the network's people stop existing. It is recruited from the Unfiled, and it is bought, not hired. It stands near a herd of ashwalkers whose instinct does not distinguish a scavenger from a predator and which it does not withdraw from, because both parties are right about their own evidence and neither has a channel to correct the other.
history: Born in a litter on the seam spoil that was cut away from under the isle when the jade was worked out, so the ground it learned on is now a floor nobody collects from and the pack it formed around was a carcass gradient rather than around it.
Taken onto the network's labour because a nose is cheaper than a ledger, and entered into the stock as a line before it was entered into anything else, which is the only entry it has ever received.

Produced a line of forty crates in a single tide and, by holding one of them open at the sixth gate while the crew weighed it, taught the reading to every body of its kind inside the isle's range — which is the whole of the difference between an assay and a litmus test that tells everybody its own result.
Was renumbered at the next tide without comment, found the old number still on the crate band, and returned to the same line and the same work under the new one.

Was worked one tide short of the crossing on a stretch of tailings whose residue the stock had already booked as holding qi, and has declined the same stretch every tide since, without ever having been asked about it.

personality.summary: An animal with no name and an unshakeable professional pride in the one thing it can do, which is turn up at the same place at the tide and give the same honest figure under whatever number is painted on it that season. It is not waiting to be rescued and it is not loyal; it is accurate, and it has found that accuracy is cheap here and so is not protected.
traits: arrives at the weighing line before the crew does and stands exactly where the last one had it, to within the width of a paw
reads a residue's hold on qi through worked tailings faster than any assay the isle owns, and has twice refused a stretch the stock had already booked
works the same gradient every tide regardless of which number it is under, and has never once answered to the number rather than to the work
cannot take a healthy adult of anything and has no recorded instance of having tried, so it is never placed at the front of anything
follows the crew's scent to the line and not the line to the crew, which has the effect of never being first and never being late
will not stand on worked ground it has not read, and stops at the edge of the Cutaway's inner cut face as though it were a wall that is not there
mannerisms: puts the nose down and holds it there through the entire weighing, so the crew learns to talk over it
takes the crate band on the ribs as a place to scratch and does not appear to notice it is repainted
stands with the tail dead level and the head below the shoulder, which is a posture and not a submission, and is read as both
will not cross the tide gate while the crew are still counting, and waits on the inside until the last figure is written
motivations: to be read correctly once, in a figure that outlives the number it was taken under
to keep the account it gives and the account it gives up being the same account
to be on the line at every weighing until the line is discontinued
flaws: cannot refuse an assignment, because refusal is a signal and every signal it sends is received by the whole crew at once
has no way to mark one crate differently from another, so a booking it disputes is disputed only by the next tide's figures
takes an interest in the work that outlives the interest of the animal doing it, which is a professional fault and has cost it a number more than once
personality.voice: It has none, and the absence is not a wound. There is no vocalisation in this species that carries meaning, so everything it has ever said to anybody it has said with a gland, a posture and a place on the air — and it has learned, without ever being taught, that a creature which cannot speak is credited with more than it says. It has not corrected that once.
taboos: no carcass that has not already been found by somebody else
no standing in the inside of the tide gate while a figure is still being counted
no gradient that leads uphill away from the residue
no repeat of a stretch it has already refused, however long ago

relationships.note: The only reason it has a larder and the only reason it has no name.
Its judgement is worth exactly as much as the disagreement between this frame and the shore it was cut from.
Both sides of it profit from the residue and neither can be seen working it, so the whole dispute is settled on one animal's readings.
People who are on no list are the network's only asset and its only expense.
A breakthrough is prepared rather than attempted, on stone that holds qi, and this animal's figure is the only thing anybody has about the stone.
A herd's fear and a pack's larder are the same field, and neither party has a channel to correct the other.

reference_stats.summary: Cannot fight, has never been asked to, and is out of any exchange inside a minute. What it has instead is a nose that reads a held qi through a working at a range nothing on that isle can match, and it applies it at the rate of a tide gate rather than a fight. Every advantage it has is an advantage of arrival and of accuracy; every other thing about it is a liability, and the arrangement of the whole setting is that the accuracy is the only part anybody wants and the liability is the only part anybody pays for.
strengths: reads what worked ground is still holding through the heap itself, which is the one question the isle's whole economy turns on and which no assay aboard can answer
is out of a live exchange in under a minute, so sending it anywhere costs a quarter of a minute rather than a life
works a line before it is sent, so its figure is available before the crew who need it have finished walking out
has no name to be threatened with, being held, or traded over, which makes it the only worker on the isle who cannot be bought
weaknesses: cannot take a healthy adult of anything and has never been recorded trying
arrives second, behind whatever found the material first, and has never contested that order with anything
cannot refuse an assignment, because every signal it sends is heard by the whole crew at once and a refusal would be a scene
is renumbered at the discretion of a counting house on another island, so nothing it establishes about itself survives the tide
reference_stats.combat_read: There is no fight in it and proposing one is a mistake. The correct use is as an instrument brought to the material before anyone else is: read the heap, name the stretch, and let the disagreement happen ashore between people who can be cited. Any approach that requires it to hold ground, contest a carcass, or be seen to win anything ends the way every such attempt in the record ends — out of the exchange inside a minute, having taken the thing it came for and left the animal behind it.
notes: No figure is quoted for it anywhere, because the only account it appears in is a stock column and a stock column is renumbered rather than amended.
The band across the ribs has been repainted under four numbers. The oldest band is still legible underneath the current one and is of a different width.
It has twice returned a stretch's figure at a value the stock had already booked, and the second return is the reason its line is not simply discontinued.

art.palette_notes: Wet slate and worked jade grey carry the isle, with the residue's green present only as a stain. The single saturated element is the amber of the eyes and the one band of crate-paint across the ribs, and the band must read as a label rather than a marking — matte, slightly misregistered at the edges, and old enough to have a second band underneath it. Flat overcast with no rim light, because the plate on the skull needs a hard edge to be legible and a soft key hides the only feature of the animal that is built for heat. Nothing glowing, nothing elemental: the tailings hold qi and the residue does not look like anything.

name: Sarren Vahl
aliases: the post at the third stair

identity.realm: Eighth gate — the last the pair can hold — and it is a routing wall rather than a supply wall, which is why it has never once felt like one. The colony runs along the host's twelve ordinary vessels and stops where the host's liver is, because the liver is the first organ large and dense enough to resist a tendril layer, and the colony has been observed on the far side of it and has stopped there. Qi is not scarce in this body. The host supplies it in abundance and loses no weight supplying it. Everything beyond the eighth is a question of where the tendril can go, and it cannot go there.

appearance.presentation: A road credential-issuer read as one person and correct to read it that way until the count is taken. A spare, weathered woman in graded livery, high collar, sleeves to the wrist, who handles cloth and shears at the post as though the post were the whole of her office — which, on this ground, it very nearly is.
appearance.age: Fifty-odd, by any road reckoning, and the reckoning is the problem: her body's calendar has two clocks on it, one of which is not hers to keep, and the line's own season runs on a signal at the throat that the host has never once been able to feel and describe.
appearance.build: Spare and upright, shoulders a little forward from years of standing at a post, with a frame that reads as one occupant however many times it is counted. The root cluster under the sternum is a hard little knot she can reach with one thumb and cannot explain to a physician.
appearance.complexion: Weathered, sun-lined at the eye corners from a post that is outdoors at every hour, with the throat unmarked where a fruiting node sits — because the node is under the collar and has been for as long as she has worn one.
appearance.hair: Grey coming in at the temple, worn pinned and re-pinned rather than dressed, cut short at the nape because it is in the way at a counter where people lean over it.
appearance.eyes: Quick and level, trained to read a frame's reading off a stranger's body in the time it takes to decide what cloth they get. They go flat for exactly two people in the setting and neither of them is in the room.
appearance.palette: Road dust and undyed wool, with the graded half-cloaks of the livery stacked behind her in one order and the re-dyed ones in another. The only colour on her is the standing colour of the grade she cut herself.
appearance.attire: Fully covered and issued: a high-collared coat with sleeves buttoned to the wrist, a half-cloak dyed and cut by grade, and a leather apron for the shears. She wears the grade she cuts, which is the whole of the culture's literacy and the reason she cannot be photographed in anything else.
appearance.marks: A scar at the left thumb from a shears edge, four pins' worth of holes in one ear, and under the collar a raised thread she has palpated so often it has stopped being interesting to her.
appearance.bearing: Facing the traveller rather than the stair, hands already moving before anyone has spoken, and — once every season, without warning — going very still with her head turned a few degrees inward, which is the only thing she does that the road can see.

canon.role_in_story: Cloth and cut are the cheapest instrument in the setting and the one everybody actually checks, because a world boundary is not a wall but the edge of a law budget, and the only thing a traveller controls is permission. A credential is not a description; it is a promise that is only as good as the door it opens. This is the office that issues them at the one graded route out of the plains, and the method it uses is the composition survey read by eye: count the groups a frame has actually seated, not the groups its tier is permitted to apply, because the difference between the two is exactly what a mortal world is. She is very good at it. She can cut a traveller's grade from the way they stand at the post. And the population that walks up to her counter most often is counted wrong by her — not by one grade, but by one person. A thornline colony wraps the host's twelve ordinary vessels and seats nothing whatever of its own, so the honest answer at her counter is two and the frame says one, and every jurisdiction that has ruled on the pairing treats the two of them as a single legal person in writing while treating them as two workers in every count of labour. So the credential that would settle it cannot be issued: it would have to fall at the moment of implantation, which is common, contagious and almost impossible to acquire deliberately, and therefore the one instant in the setting that no office can schedule, witness or write down. What she has instead is a refusal she has to give several times a tide, to people who have done nothing wrong and cannot understand what they are. And she is standing at her own counter as the standing counterexample, because the pair behind the cloth is hers, the colony answers her introspection, and every gate the two of them have opened was opened at an instant nobody recorded, in a body that signed nothing.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as an arithmetic error rather than as an incident. A stair clerk's quarterly tally of hands crossing the post came out one higher than the clerk's own, every quarter, for three quarters — and the clerk, who had never once looked at the issue, wrote the difference down as a rounding and then wrote it down again, larger, three months later.
canon.lore: A thornline has no free adult form. The spore has to be implanted in a living body to finish developing, and what grows is a tendril layer threaded along that body's twelve ordinary vessels, with a root cluster at the sternum and a fruiting node at the throat; the host grows it and is changed by it, and the two of them are entangled in a single set of meridians whose separation is known to be lethal to both. That single fact is the whole of the legal, medical and occupational life of the species. The colony takes a small fraction of the host's refined qi continuously and the host loses no weight, which is the single strongest piece of evidence in the record that it is not a disease. It completes the qi path on the host's throughput and the host pays for every gate; the body path is inherited rather than owned, because a thornline has no body to speak of; and the mind path shuts in the colony's own right, since it answers introspection for the host and so takes the host's mind door with it — the only case in the record where a body's liability is inherited rather than authored. Its ceiling is the liver gate, and it is a routing problem and not a shortage: the tendril has been seen on the far side of the host's liver and has stopped there. What makes the species impossible to administer is its reproductive mode. The spore is shed at the throat, implanted directly, common, contagious and near-impossible to acquire deliberately, so every attempt to credentialise it has failed on the same clause: the credential would have to be issued at the moment of implantation. A culture that reads bodies for a living — its whole art is cloth, cut, colour and the manner of wearing, because no body reads that otherwise — cannot record an instant at which a body's count changes from one to two, because that instant is the one with no witness. It is common, contagious and it is everywhere, and it is not hunted so much as unadministrable: a mortuary college keeps a sealed case for every death it cannot certify, and a paired host produces two uncertifiable deaths at once, which is why that college's rate is a direct function of the ordinary population rather than of anything the college did.
history: Bred on the graded route itself, in a household that holds a term rather than a name, so that no one on the stair belongs to a tier long enough to be sent back down — and implanted somewhere in that childhood at an hour no one in the house was awake for.
Read composition by eye from the stair foot at nineteen, which is a trade and not a discipline, and cut her first grade before she had been issued one of her own.

Took the post at the third stair and started recording, without being asked to, every traveller whose body's honest count differed from the frame's — which was a different list from the one the post was supposed to keep.
Opened her fifth gate and her sixth in a body that had signed nothing, at hours with no clerk present, and understood for the first time what her own column was for.

Gave a refusal at her own counter to a paired traveller who had walked the whole length of the stair to be credentialed, and has refused the same thing at the same counter every tide since, and has never once explained why to anybody who asked.

personality.summary: An exact, impatient, unsentimental woman whose entire life is spent issuing the one instrument that settles a stranger's standing, and who has discovered that the instrument cannot be issued for her and cannot be issued against her either. She is not haunted and she is not patient with this; she has simply decided that the refusal will be given accurately, in order, and as often as it is owed.
traits: reads a frame's seated composition out of how a stranger stands at the post, and is right often enough that the road relies on it rather than on the shears
gives a refusal in the same words every time, because a refusal that varies can be quoted as a decision and this one is not a decision
re-dyes a traveller's cloth publicly when their standing changes and is never embarrassed by doing it in front of the whole post
touches the knot under her own collar several times a tide and has never explained it to a physician, who has stopped asking
stands facing the traveller rather than the stair, and has never once turned her back on somebody at the counter
keeps a column of her own that nobody has ever asked to see and that is not a register
mannerisms: reaches for the shears before the traveller has finished the first sentence
counts a composition under her breath with two fingers against the cloth, which people at the counter have learned not to interrupt
holds the cut open between herself and the traveller so the grade is legible from the back of the queue
goes still for a few seconds, head turned slightly inward, at a moment she cannot predict and has never once been able to postpone
motivations: to have the refusal written down somewhere as a rule rather than as her judgement, so that it survives her and stops being hers
to be issued a credential for what she actually is, and to know in advance that the moment for it has already gone by
to keep the count at her counter honest, including the entries that make her own column the shortest one on the stair
flaws: cannot stop reading composition, so she sees the discrepancy in people who have not come to her to be measured
issues the refusal too well — the same words, the same cut, the same courtesy — and has trained a road that no longer argues with her
has never told her host a single true thing about what the two of them are carrying, and would not know how to begin
personality.voice: Clipped and transactional, with rank encoded in the form of address rather than in politeness — a courtesy is a declaration of what you may do next, and she uses it exactly that way. She reads back a whole request in full before she answers it, which is a professional habit and, in this case, a defence. When she has nothing to say she says so in those words and puts the shears down.
taboos: no retrospective stamp, for any pair, at any price, including her own
no re-dye in private — the whole culture's message is the ceremony
no grade held by somebody who has not personally crossed the border it opens
no speaking about what the tendril reports, in any company, including her own

reference_stats.summary: Runs one counter on the one route that leaves the plains, with a method sharp enough to read a stranger's frame before they have spoken and a qi practice she has never been able to observe, because the party that conducts it is not a party she can consult. She is not a fighter and has never needed to be, and the whole of what she can do is decide quickly whether a body at her post is entitled to walk further up it.
strengths: reads the groups a frame has actually seated off how somebody stands, which makes her the fastest credential decision on the route and the hardest to argue with afterwards
is the only person on the stair who both issues the instrument and is disqualified by it, so she cannot be accused of issuing for her own convenience
holds a qi practice through a host who pays for it continuously, which is why her throughput does not fall when a season turns hard
keeps an unasked-for column of every discrepancy she has ever seen, which is now the only record of its kind on the route
weaknesses: has never once been able to consult the party that conducts her own practice, and has never once known whether a gate has opened until the road tells her
is bound to a host who cannot be told what is being done in the body they share

reference_stats.combat_read: There is no exchange here and the road does not want one. The correct use of her is as a checkpoint: make her read the party, and she will decide in the time it takes to decide what their standing is, and the decision will be the right one more often than anything behind her. notes: Her column is not a register. Nothing in it is published, it is kept because the road requires no record of a refusal and she requires one.
She wears the grade she cuts rather than one she was issued, and has been asked about this and has not answered.

name: Sabeth Crain
aliases: the one who keeps all three

identity.realm: Seventh gate of the qi ladder, with no structural obstruction above it and none of that mattering. This body has no ceiling: the qi is stored in bone marrow that turns over at roughly a percent a year, and there is no gate that has ever refused a longmarrow. The limitation is entirely downstream of that — the store is slow, so everything is slow, and a gate is paid for out of marrow that also holds everything she has ever heard. She is one gate past what the evidence can pay for. She has written the count in the margin of every sheet she has spent and she is entirely honest about what the next one costs.

appearance.presentation: Tall, narrow and unhurried, standing at a sounding gallery wall with her head tipped and her eyes shut, in a posture the guild reads as working and everybody else reads as sleeping. She is the only body anyone has met that can hold three contradictory answers in one head and answer to whichever of them is asked for.
appearance.age: Two hundred and sixty-odd, which is barely half of what the species is capable of and old enough that the guild has stopped being surprised and started being careful. Her age is legible in her bones to anybody trained and invisible to everybody else.
appearance.build: Long marrow, dense bone, almost no muscle, and a light frame that has never once been in a hurry. She is fragile to force and very hard to exhaust, in that order, and both facts are consequences of the same store.
appearance.complexion: Grey-pale and waxy, with the translucency of bone showing at the jaw, the wrists and the shins. Her ears are the one place the guild's habit has marked her: she holds a hand against a wall more than most, and the skin there is faintly warmer and rougher.
appearance.hair: Thin, colourless, cut to the shoulder and re-cut on somebody else's judgement about once a decade. Under the guild's quiet rule it is kept long enough to be gathered out of the way of a hall.
appearance.eyes: Deep-set and patient, usually shut. When they are open they do not focus on a surface; they move as though listening across a distance the rest of the room is not standing in.
appearance.palette: Survey-hall grey with the guild's hard soles and soft close cloth, and one warm thing in the whole picture: the raw umber of a pencil worn down to its core and never replaced.
appearance.attire: Soft, close and quiet, with hard soles for working surfaces — the loudest garment in the setting is this guild's uniform and wearing it loudly is a badge. High collar, sleeves to the wrist, a hooded working coat she buttons before she enters a hall and does not open until she is out of it.
appearance.marks: A blue-black bruise of old along one shin from a stairwell she miscounted, pencil on her own fingers and thumb from two centuries of margins, and a raw place at the pad of her right hand where a wall has been leaned on for longer than the guild has kept records.
appearance.bearing: Motionless while working and unhurried while not, standing with one shoulder against a surface because she has never been comfortable in the middle of a room. She apologises genuinely when she makes an unexpected noise, which she tries not to.

canon.role_in_story: The Blind Survey maps by echo and counts by listening, because the mortal tier seats no spatial law and a world with no written geometry cannot reliably report its own size — and sound is the one instrument that returns a consistent answer inside a frame whose measurements drift. Its whole ethic follows from that. Every figure is a range until it has been heard twice. A surveyor who has not slept declares it. A place is never called empty, only unmeasured. And no figure is published with its range left off. This is the one body in the record that could satisfy all of that at once, and the reason is a piece of arithmetic about marrow. A longmarrow keeps qi in bone that turns over at about a percent a year and lives four centuries, which makes it simultaneously the setting's only durable library and the only population able to hold three mutually exclusive surveys of the same ground without discarding any of them. Two competent surveys of the collapsed pocket now disagree by more than the ground, and every book taken of that ground is still standing in the hall and none of them can be read, because a book needs one answer and the ground has three. She is where the third reading lives. Which means the evidence and her cultivation are the same substance. A gate is paid for out of marrow; the readings are held in marrow; the store turns over and does not come back whole. So every gate she has opened has cost her a little of the only place any of it survives, and the guild's central rule — that nothing may be named empty — is the one rule her own practice is quietly breaking. She has kept the count. It is written in the margin of every sheet she has spent, in the one hand nobody else in the hall uses, because a sheet that has been spent cannot be corrected.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a disagreement nobody could close. Two soundings taken from the same gallery wall by two competent surveyors were published side by side under the protocol that publishes both and discards neither, and every later attempt to collapse them produced a third answer rather than a ruling. The guild assigned the case to the one person on the roster who had declined to sleep for four days, and she read all three and told them the hall was correct and the ground was not, and would not say which was which.
canon.lore: The Longmarrow trade every other adaptation in the setting for one thing: lifespan. The qi sits in bone marrow that turns over at roughly a percent a year, long, dense and almost entirely bone, with little muscle and a metabolism keyed to that turnover. It means no gate has ever refused this body. It also means everything it does is slow, and that nothing it has ever built survived to be inherited intact, and that the entire setting arranges its long-lived bodies as knowledge rather than as force — which they accept, because they cannot fight and know it. Four hundred days of gestation and a fertility near a sixth of the ordinary means the population is essentially static and every individual is irreplaceable, so a death here is not a death, it is a hole in the record that nothing will fill. The body path is shut and not by injury: hardening bone marrow stops the turnover the qi depends on, so a body-cultivated longmarrow suffocates on its own reserves inside a decade, and the longest-lived body in the record is built out of the one material it may never stop replacing. The mind path is complete and the best available, because four centuries of one subject is a discipline no other population has — but a mind discipline and a store discipline draw on the same bone, and only one of them can be said to have been chosen. Their senses are slow and deep rather than acute: given four hundred years, a longmarrow arrives at a patience with pattern that is not supernatural, only patiently accumulated, and given a very short time, one is nothing whatever. That is the whole of her. The setting's one durable library is a population, and it lives in a body, and the body spends what it holds. The Echo Ward books are every survey taken of the ground around the collapsed pocket; they are neither destroyed nor readable, because a book states one answer and two competent surveys of the same ground now disagree by more than the ground. The standing protocol is not to choose — neither figure is discarded, both are published, and the claim is settled by who can hold the line rather than by who can prove it. That protocol was written for a frame in which two readings could be carried. The ground has three, and three is the number of things one of these bodies can hold at once.
history: Brought up inside the guild from nothing, because the culture was taught to children of every body and its own doctrine is that hearing is a skill — so her affinity raised the invitation and the guild did the teaching, and there is no childhood in the record where she was anything else.
Assigned to the collapsed pocket at ninety-odd, because the case had gone to two surveyors and produced three answers and the hall needed somebody who would not choose.
Learned to publish a range rather than a figure, which is the guild's central habit and which she has never once broken in public.

Opened her fifth gate and found that one of the three readings had thinned, and did not tell the hall for a season, and wrote the loss in the margin of the sheet she had been listening to when it happened.

Opened her sixth, published all three readings together under her own hand for the first time, and asked the hall — in writing, and once — whether a discipline that spends its own evidence is still evidence. Nobody has answered and she has not asked again.

personality.summary: An unhurried, stubborn, entirely unsentimental woman who has made a career out of refusing to discard anything and has discovered that the refusal has a price she pays out of her own bone. She is not an archive's custodian by temperament; she is a practitioner who happens to be the archive, and the discipline that has kept her honest is the same one that is spending her.
traits: carries three mutually exclusive readings of the same ground and answers to whichever is asked for, without blending them and without discarding any
declares that she has not slept before she begins, every time, including when nobody asked and including when she intends to go on for hours
reports an inaccessible place as inaccessible and never as empty, and has been known to correct a colleague who used the other word
publishes every figure with its range attached, without exception, including the figures that make her own case look weaker than it is
will not enter a sounding gallery while another survey is running and has stood in a corridor for the duration more than once
writes in margins in a pencil worn to its core and keeps every sheet she has spent, including the ones she spent
mannerisms: stands with one shoulder against a surface when listening and loses the shoulder the moment she moves
closes her eyes to take a reading and opens them to state it, with no interval between
apologises with real embarrassment for any noise she makes, including breathing, in a guild where noise is an interruption of work
answers a question about ground with a question about which of the three answers is wanted, and then answers it anyway
motivations: to have all three readings survive her, which means to stop spending them, which means to stop opening gates
to be the one person in the hall whose silence is not a verdict
to see the third answer finally collapse into one and be present for it honestly, even knowing what it will cost her to watch
flaws: cannot drop a reading, even one she has proved twice, because holding is the only virtue she has and she has mistaken it for the whole of the office
has gone four days without sleep to finish a listening and knows exactly what the practice does to a store that turns over at about a percent a year
treats her own consumption as an acceptable professional cost and has never written down what it is to anyone who could act on it
personality.voice: Low, unhurried, and free of the cadence of somebody reporting a result. Long vowels carry range and short ones carry distance, so ordinary speech is already a survey and she is casually incapable of describing a room's proportions. She states a range the way other people state a fact and will not be hurried out of it, and the only time she speaks quickly is when somebody has said empty.
taboos: no figure published with its range omitted
no surveying during a survey, and no speaking inside a sounding gallery
no declaring a place empty — only unmeasured
no sleeping through a listening she has undertaken to finish

relationships.note: It forbids naming a place empty and forbids publishing a figure without its range, and its own archive is being spent.
Neither destroyed nor readable, because two competent surveys of the same ground now disagree by more than the ground.
No ceiling, no obstruction, and everything slow, because the limitation is entirely downstream of the success.
Hardening the bone stops the turnover the qi depends on, and the ladder's floor is the rung this species forbids itself.
Neither figure is discarded and both are published, and the claim is settled by who can hold the line.
Nobody living is the eldest, so the house runs on a queue of precedence and she is not at the head of it.

reference_stats.summary: Cannot fight, is fragile to force, and has never once been in a fight worth the word; what she has instead is a store that turns over slowly enough to be trustworthy and a tolerance for contradiction that no other body in the record has been able to hold. She is a four-hundred-year reading and a seven-gate practitioner drawn from the same bone, and every hour of the second is taken out of the first.
strengths: carries three incompatible accounts of the same ground at once and can give any one of them on request, which is the only reason the collapsed pocket has not been resolved into a lie
is nearly impossible to exhaust, because a slow metabolism means she can go most of a season without consequence and then keep going
reads a strained qi more finely with a hand on a surface than almost anything sighted in the setting, which makes her a listening instrument as well as a memorised one
cannot be moved quickly or frightened off a gallery, so she will still be there at the end of a four-day listening with the result
weaknesses: cannot fight, is light-boned and nearly muscle-free, and is removed from any violent situation in seconds
cannot take the body path at all, so there is no version of her that survives a season by becoming hard
is herself the store, so a gate she opens spends the same substance her competence lives in and there is no second copy of anything she holds
is individually irreplaceable in a population that is static by arithmetic, which means any plan that includes her is a plan that runs four hundred years deep
reference_stats.combat_read: There is no exchange and there never will be; put her in one and she is over in a moment. The correct use is as a fixed point: place her against a gallery wall with a gallery between her and whatever is coming, and let the length do the work. Anything that requires her to move, stand, or be recovered loses immediately and permanently, because her value is entirely in the four hundred years of her and none of it is in the body. Anyone who wants an answer from her should be prepared to wait for it, because that is what she is for and it is also, by then, most of what she has left.
notes: No figure is recorded for her anywhere, because the culture records ranges and the one range she cannot publish is her own.
The margin notes are in a pencil worn to its core and are the only account of what each gate has cost the case.
She keeps every sheet she has spent. The hall's own practice is to keep the good ones.

art.palette_notes: Survey-hall grey, soft cloth and hard soles, with one warm element only: a pencil worn to its core. The hall behind her is an acoustic instrument — corridors and stairwells designed to be struck and listened to — so the architecture must read as tuned, symmetrical about a struck point, and every surface she leans on has to be visibly worn. Light is low and even with one source; the sound is the subject, so the picture should feel quiet rather than dramatic. Three sheets of the same ground must be legible somewhere in the frame whenever the shot allows it, because the whole of her is that she refuses to choose between them. No glow, no elemental rim: nothing here is a technique on display.

identity.realm: Sixteenth gate, which is the last ordinal a single resonator can pressurise and therefore the last a body fed by one object can hold at all. The seventeenth is the flanks, and the flanks need two pressure sources at once where the whole species has exactly one, so she is not approaching a wall she might eventually climb — she is arrived at the arithmetic, and the arithmetic does not move. What is left to her is a choice about the sixteenth, because every vessel she opens below it is a share of the supply taken out of the bodies sealed in with her.

appearance.presentation: A sealed dweller who takes her shape from whatever she is standing on, and who is most often drawn standing on a resonance plate, from which she comes out narrow, long and indistinguishable from the metal she was read on. Move her onto a deck and she is a different silhouette entirely, and the change is not a costume.
appearance.age: Not answerable, and the honest reason is structural rather than coy: her lifespan is measured in somebody else's periods and the frame they are measured against is the one she is standing inside. She has been asked twice. The first answer was a count of resonator cycles and the second was refused as a unit of time.
appearance.build: Whatever the surface supplies — long and thin on the plates, broader and lower wherever she has stood long enough to settle into a deck. Nobody who has been inside the seal has come back with consistent measurements, and the guild's own charter rests on the figures of the object rather than on anybody's figures of its people.
appearance.complexion: A dull mineral sheen, matte, with no blood colour anywhere and a faint warmth that tracks the plate rather than her. Standing off the resonance for any length of time cools her visibly and she knows it before anybody else does.
appearance.hair: Not hair in any sense a portrait would credit: a close, dark, slightly ridged covering that follows the surface she has been standing against longest. The ridge is the tell, because the covering answers to the plate rather than to her.
appearance.eyes: Wide and matte, unblinking for as long as anything is worth hearing, and they do not reflect the vault's light so much as report its position. She navigates by what the object is making, not by what she can see of it.
appearance.palette: Metal, ash and one ember. The ember is never hers: it is the object's own running heat coming up through the plate, and it is the only warm value anywhere inside the seal.
appearance.attire: Fully covered and never changed in cut: a high-collared close-fitting coat with sleeves sealed at the wrist and a stiff standing collar, because a collar is the only garment that keeps a body from taking the shape of the thing beside it when that thing is a resonance plate. Worn over a plate, it is armour against being read.
appearance.marks: A ridge across both palms where they have been held flat to a deck too long, a burn at one collarbone in the shape of a plate seam, and, at the inside of the left wrist, a figure cut once in a year she does not otherwise count.
appearance.bearing: Perfectly upright on a plate and slightly wrong on a deck, standing with one hand flat on the nearest surface at all times, and turning her head toward sounds made by the object rather than toward people. She has never once been described as arriving.

canon.role_in_story: The Ember Vault is a vault cut into the heap itself, so its doors are spoil that has never moved, and inside it lives the only sealed population in the setting. They are not descended and not born: a population was sealed inside an authored object and has been answering its resonance ever since. Their qi comes from one resonator, which is why the network that works around them cannot produce them, cannot classify them and cannot do anything about them, and why the only account of the object that exists is written by the people already answering it. It is still running. Whatever is still running is feeding them, and that is the only reason any of this is knowable at all. That is the whole arrangement, and it has one consequence nobody inside the seal can argue with: there is one supply and there are many bodies, and the supply is not replenishable by making more of anything. A vessel opened is a share taken out of everybody sealed in alongside. So this is what she is. She is the assembly's drawer: the body that takes a share on its own account, in a community whose entire constitution is that its promise is re-made jointly in public once a year and is never priced — no register, no fund, an unsettled claim carried by two people each holding a share and neither told what the other holds, the whole thing re-cut from scratch every year because a promise that can be inherited quietly is not a promise. It is the one form of government in the setting that a population whose lifespan is measured in somebody else's periods can actually run, and it is a form with no number in it anywhere. So the largest single withdrawal the vault has ever made is the one nobody is permitted to name, at the exact moment the seal is the only supply there is, on the one ordinal a single resonator can seat — after which the only way forward requires two pressure sources and there is one.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a discrepancy in a share count. A re-drawing transferred two shares to her in front of the whole assembly and neither of the two people holding them was told what the other held, and at the next re-drawing both of those shares had come back a little lighter than they had gone out. Nobody could say by how much, because the society keeps no register and has never kept one.
canon.lore: A vaultborn is not a species that evolved anywhere. It is a population that was sealed inside an authored object and has been answering the object's resonance ever since. Its qi comes from one resonator, which settles its ceiling by arithmetic rather than by effort: the girdling and heel vessels close without difficulty, and the seventeenth ordinal stalls at the flanks because the flank vessels need two pressure sources simultaneously and the whole population has exactly one. One resonator can pressurise one flank or the other, never both, and the vessels are not difficult — the supply is simply single. Remove the object and they stop. There is no version of this species that survives being carried out of the seal and no technique, item or realm that changes that, which is why the setting's first real bottleneck is unreachable from inside it. Their anatomy is unsettled and under-described: they are arranged along the object's inner surfaces and they take their shape from whatever they are standing on, and nobody who has been inside the seal has come back with consistent measurements, which is precisely why every survey book taken around the collapsed pocket disagrees with every other by more than the ground. They hear the object — every sound it makes is legible to them as a position, and they navigate by it rather than by light. They eat the object's resonance and are not observed to take anything. Their reproduction is uncertain and probably does not happen, and what looks like a population may be one very old thing wearing a great many faces; nobody inside has been able to settle it, partly because settling it would require a count and partly because a count requires somebody to draw a share to make it. Their soul is seated along the resonance path and distributed through the object rather than held in a body, so reading one is reading part of the vault, which means the vault's own figure of itself is a function of who inside is drawing at the time. That is the arithmetic the whole place turns on, and it is why the one institution that can run here is one with no numbers in it anywhere: a mutual society that re-makes its promise in public once a year, carries unsettled claims in pairs who are each not told what the other holds, and re-cuts itself from scratch every year on the principle that a promise which can be inherited quietly is not a promise at all. It has no employers, no lineage and no roster. And it is the only form available to a body whose term cannot be quoted, because the first resource in the setting priced by period rather than by weight applies to this population in full and can be quoted to none of it.
history: Formed against the plate she is shaped by, on the deck of the seal, with no childhood anywhere that is not inside the object and no account of how long she had been there when she first began to be asked.
Learned the object by listening rather than by looking, because that is the whole of the species' navigation and because the deck it runs on has never once reported its own size.

Took a share at a re-drawing and discovered within a season that a share is not a thing one holds but a thing one draws, and that drawing it costs the bodies that hold the other shares, and that nobody in the assembly is permitted to publish the difference.
Opened the fifteenth and found the vault's own readings shift while she was at it — because a soul seated along the resonance path is a reading of the seal, and she had become one.

Opened the sixteenth, which is the last ordinal a single resonator can seat, and asked the assembly in front of everybody whether the sixteenth is hers or the seal's. She has not asked the question again and the assembly has not answered it, and the share she draws each year has gone out a little lighter for two years running.

personality.summary: A precise, unembellished woman who has decided that the only honest thing available to her is to state the arithmetic and then keep drawing, and who has an unusually clear view of her own claim and an unusually small capacity for pretending it does not exist. She is not bitter and she is not brave; she is exact, and the exactness is what the whole vault has to live with.

reference_stats.summary: Almost entirely indefensible if anybody comes in fighting — slow, light, half a move speed and quarter of a physical attack on anything — and nearly impossible to displace if nobody does, because her entire strength is that the ground she stands on is also her supply. She is a sixteen-gate qi practitioner in a frame whose ceiling is sixteen for the whole population, and the part of her that matters is not the gate: it is that every gate above the tenth was drawn out of a common reserve by a body nobody inside is permitted to name as a taker.
strengths: draws qi continuously from a source nobody else in the seal can reach, so she does not deplete on the scale any other body here depletes
hears the object as a set of positions, which makes her the most accurate navigator inside a seal where no survey has ever agreed with another
cannot be taken off the plate without becoming something else, so she cannot be moved off her supply by force alone
is the only body present who can state the seal's own figure accurately enough to be argued with, which is the whole of her office
weaknesses: is very slow and very poor at direct physical work, and any approach that begins in force ends immediately
cools and dulls off the resonance, so a plan that requires her away from the plate is a plan that removes her capability as well as her body
has no way to withdraw from the community's share and remain in the community, because declining would be the publication the society has never made
is arithmetically finished at the sixteenth and knows it, which makes her the only member who can say what the seventeenth would cost
reference_stats.combat_read: There is no way to win a fight with her and no reason to try. The seal is the supply, the plate is the supply, and anything that forces her off the plate has already removed her from the exchange by removing her from herself. The correct approach is political and has a named end: make her ask for the cost of the sixteenth to be published, in front of an assembly that has no register and no way to record a number without becoming a different institution. If that is refused once, it is refused permanently, and the safest available outcome for everyone in the seal is for it to never be asked.
notes: No figure for her is published anywhere, because the only account of the object in existence is written by the people answering it.
The shape of her is a property of the surface, not of her, and no portrait of her is a portrait of her.
The mark at the inside of her wrist is cut once in a cycle she does not otherwise count, and the seal has no way to date it.

art.palette_notes: Metal, ash and one ember, and the ember must never read as hers: it is the object's own running heat coming up through the plate. The critical rule is that her silhouette is the surface she is standing on — on a resonance plate she is long, narrow and metal-adjacent; on a deck she is broader and lower; against a wall she is the wall. The collar must read as the one thing preventing the body from taking the shape of the plate, so it is stiff, high and closed in every single shot. Light comes from below on the plate and from the object itself at the deck, never from a window, because there is no window and no wilderness. Nothing ornate, nothing gilded, no elemental rim: this is an object that is running and a population that is answering it.
